midlane.quote: Root them with Security Gate, stick Sticky Mine on and pop it with a Spark basic attack for the bigger hit, then Seek and Destroy as they run. Once Orion and Wraith Leggings land you can commit Tesla Dome on top.
midlane.issue: SOURCE says a basic attack empowers an attached Sticky Mine, not that it detonates ('pops') it early
midlane.rewrite: Root them with Security Gate, stick Sticky Mine on and land a Spark basic attack so the mine goes off empowered for the bigger hit, then Seek and Destroy as they run. Once Orion and Wraith Leggings land you can commit Tesla Dome on top.

jungle.quote: You lose most even jungle duels — use RMB Backlash to turn away their shots and only fight when a teammate is already there.
jungle.issue: "most even jungle duels" scans as garbled — reader can't tell if "even" is an adverb or an adjective
jungle.rewrite: You lose most jungle duels head-on — use RMB Backlash to turn away their shots and only fight when a teammate is already there.
